title: Prepare an Australian Industry Participation plan for a major project
what: The proponent of a major project must give the Australian Industry Participation Authority a draft AIP plan for approval.

sources.title: Australian Jobs Act 2013
sources.quote: 17 Project proponent must give draft AIP plan to the Authority (1) The project proponent for a major project must give the Authority a draft AIP plan for the project: (a) at least 90 days before the trigger date for the project; or (b) if the Authority, by written notice given to the project proponent, specifies a later time—before that later time.

administration.who: Department of Industry, Science and Resources

sources.title: Australian Jobs Act 2013
sources.quote: Exceptions (5) The Authority may, by legislative instrument, declare that a specified thing is not an eligible facility for the purposes of this Act.

reach.condition: if it is the proponent of a major project under the Act
